description: Complete workflow for onboarding new customers, from initial contact through successful first order and follow-up

tasks.title: Initial contact and needs assessment
tasks.description: First meeting with customer to understand their needs, budget, and timeline

tasks.title: Prepare customized proposal
tasks.description: Create proposal tailored to customer needs including pricing, timeline, and deliverables

tasks.title: Send proposal and follow up
tasks.description: Send proposal via email and schedule follow-up call to address questions

tasks.title: Negotiate terms and close deal
tasks.description: Address objections, negotiate pricing if needed, and close the sale

tasks.title: Create customer record in ERPNext
tasks.description: Set up customer in system with all contact details, billing info, and credit terms

tasks.title: Process first order
tasks.description: Create and submit first sales order, coordinate with operations for fulfillment

tasks.title: Coordinate delivery with operations
tasks.description: Work with operations team to ensure smooth first delivery

tasks.title: Post-delivery follow-up call
tasks.description: Call customer to ensure satisfaction with first order and address any issues

tasks.title: Set up recurring order schedule (if applicable)
tasks.description: Establish regular ordering cadence and automated reminders

tasks.title: 30-day relationship review
tasks.description: Review customer performance, identify upsell opportunities, address any concerns

description: End-to-end workflow for planning, executing, and analyzing a sales campaign targeting specific customer segments

tasks.title: Define campaign objectives and targets
tasks.description: Set clear goals for revenue, new customers, and product mix. Identify target customer segments

tasks.title: Develop campaign messaging and offers
tasks.description: Create compelling offers, discounts, and promotional messaging aligned with objectives

tasks.title: Prepare customer prospect list
tasks.description: Segment database, clean data, create targeted lists with contact information

tasks.title: Coordinate with marketing team
tasks.description: Align on campaign materials, email templates, social media assets, and timing

tasks.title: Train sales team on campaign
tasks.description: Brief team on objectives, messaging, offers, objection handling, and tracking procedures

tasks.title: Launch campaign - Week 1 outreach
tasks.description: Initial contact wave via email, calls, and social media to first segment

tasks.title: Follow-up with engaged prospects - Week 1
tasks.description: Call and meet with prospects who showed interest in initial outreach

tasks.title: Week 1 performance review
tasks.description: Analyze response rates, pipeline created, and adjust tactics for Week 2

tasks.title: Launch campaign - Week 2 outreach
tasks.description: Second contact wave to remaining segments plus re-engagement of Week 1 non-responders

tasks.title: Follow-up with engaged prospects - Week 2
tasks.description: Continue pipeline development with interested prospects

tasks.title: Close deals from campaign pipeline
tasks.description: Focus on converting qualified leads to closed deals before campaign end

tasks.title: Final campaign analysis and report
tasks.description: Compile results vs targets, ROI analysis, lessons learned, recommendations for future campaigns

description: Standard workflow for managing a sales opportunity from lead qualification through deal closure and handoff

tasks.title: Lead qualification and discovery
tasks.description: Qualify lead using BANT criteria (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline). Schedule discovery call

tasks.title: Conduct needs assessment meeting
tasks.description: Deep-dive call/meeting to understand pain points, requirements, decision criteria, and stakeholders

tasks.title: Document opportunity in CRM
tasks.description: Create opportunity record with estimated value, timeline, probability, and next steps

tasks.title: Develop solution and pricing
tasks.description: Design solution that meets customer needs, calculate pricing with appropriate margins

tasks.title: Internal proposal review
tasks.description: Review solution and pricing with sales manager, get approval for special terms if needed

tasks.title: Prepare and send formal proposal
tasks.description: Create professional proposal document with solution details, pricing, timeline, and terms

tasks.title: Schedule proposal presentation
tasks.description: Present proposal to decision-makers, walk through solution, address questions

tasks.title: Handle objections and concerns
tasks.description: Address any concerns raised during presentation, provide additional information as needed

tasks.title: Negotiate final terms
tasks.description: Work through pricing, payment terms, delivery schedule, and contractual details

tasks.title: Obtain internal deal approval
tasks.description: Get final sign-off from management for negotiated terms and special conditions

tasks.title: Prepare and send contract
tasks.description: Draft contract or sales agreement incorporating all agreed terms, send for customer signature

tasks.title: Close deal - obtain signed contract
tasks.description: Secure signed contract from customer, celebrate the win!

tasks.title: Create customer and order in ERPNext
tasks.description: Set up customer master data and create initial sales order

tasks.title: Handoff to operations/delivery team
tasks.description: Brief operations team on customer requirements, timeline, and special considerations

tasks.title: Kick-off meeting with customer
tasks.description: Introductions between customer and delivery team, confirm timeline and expectations
